title: Act: Add object, scene and world zod schemas
description: Create zod schemas and a non-throwing parseWorldContent mirroring manifest/index.ts parseManifest.

steps.action: Define conditionSchema as union of {flag:string, equals:boolean optional} and {hasItem:string}; actionSchema with id enum inspect|push|search|leave, label string, conditions optional array, events array of z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()) objects with a string type field; objectSchema with id, name, description, asset string, position {x,y numbers}, scale number positive default 1, layer enum background|furniture|objects|characters|effects|ui, interactionBounds boundsSchema imported from ../assets/manifest/schema optional, actions array, visibleWhen conditionSchema array optional, persistentState {flag string, initial boolean optional} optional, openWhenFlag string optional.

Define sceneSchema (id, title, openingDialogue optional, dialogue array of records, objects array of objectSchema) and worldSchema (id, title, startScene, scenes string array, characters array of {id,name}, flags string array). Export parseWorldContent(kind: 'scene'|'world', input: unknown) returning {ok:true,data}|{ok:false,errors:{path,message}[]} via safeParse, joining issue.path with '.'.
steps.code: export function parseWorldContent(kind, input) { const r = (kind==='scene'?sceneSchema:worldSchema).safeParse(input); ... }
steps.expected: Invalid input returns errors, never throws
